title: Cartivo
description: Cartivo needed to run product sales, court and service bookings, seller subscriptions, and a rewards wallet on one platform — with real money moving through four different checkout flows at once, backed by a Maya payment integration. As one of the developers on the team, I owned the Products Management System end-to-end, from ERD to REST API to implementation, keeping product data reliable and consistent alongside the bookings, subscriptions, and payment flows running in parallel.

title: EMR Web App
description: Clinic staff needed one system to move a patient through admission, outpatient visits, billing, and clinical records without the process breaking down between departments. I built an EMR web app that handles all four in one interface designed for clinic staff, not developers, using Next.js, NestJS, Prisma, and TypeScript. The clinic gets a single, connected record from check-in through billing instead of separate tools for each step.

title: RentHub
description: Landlords running several boarding houses or apartment buildings need to track units, rent, and tenants across every property, often while off-site. I built RentHub, a cross-platform rental management system with unit tracking, billing, and tenant management, plus a dedicated mobile app so landlords can manage things from their phone instead of a desktop. Built with Next.js, React Native, NestJS, and Prisma — one connected system for the property side of the business.

title: Clinic Birthing Center
description: A birthing center and clinic needed to move a patient through admission, outpatient visits, billing, and medical records without losing their history between departments. I built a clinic and birthing-center management system that handles all four in one place, with SignalR powering real-time updates between staff. Built with C# .NET, SQL Server, and jQuery, it gives the clinic a single system to manage a patient from admission through billing.

title: LinQue
description: Front offices handling more than one kind of request — inquiries, transactions, and more — need a queue that keeps each category moving without lines backing up into each other. I built LinQue, a smart queuing system that separates requests by category and pushes updates in real time with SignalR, so staff and customers always know who's next. Built with C# .NET, SQL Server, and jQuery.

title: JCode Leads AI
description: Every submission on this site's contact form is a warm lead, and the worst thing that can happen to one is sitting unread in an inbox for a day. I built JCode Leads AI, an automation wired directly into my own contact form: the moment a visitor submits it, the entry is appended to a running Excel sheet — name, contact details, project type, and message — an email notification lands in my inbox with the full submission, and a text message goes straight to my phone so I see it within minutes, wherever I am, instead of whenever I next check email. Built with n8n, the Google Sheets API, Nodemailer, and Twilio for SMS, it makes sure no inbound lead from this site goes more than a few minutes without me knowing about it.

title: JobScout AI
description: Job hunting eats hours a day if you're checking LinkedIn manually — new postings show up at random times, and titles rarely match reality, so half the listings you open aren't even relevant. I built JobScout AI, a scheduled automation that triggers every evening at 6 PM, pulls new postings matching my target roles — Software Engineer, Full-Stack Developer, AI Automation — and has an AI model read and score each listing for actual fit instead of just keyword-matching the title, then logs the qualified ones into a running Excel sheet with company, role, and link. It emails me a daily digest, and for postings that list a recruiter's number, sends a WhatsApp message too, so I can follow up the same evening instead of days later. Built with n8n, Apify, the OpenAI API, Google Sheets, and the WhatsApp Business API, it turned an hour of manual scrolling into a five-minute review every night.

title: NoShowGuard
description: Clinics and service businesses lose real revenue to no-shows, and calling every client by hand to confirm doesn't scale past a handful of bookings a day. I built NoShowGuard, an automation that sends AI-personalized reminders by SMS and WhatsApp ahead of every appointment, understands free-text replies like 'can we move it to Friday' well enough to reschedule against the real calendar automatically, and flags at-risk bookings early enough for staff to step in. Built with n8n, the OpenAI API, Twilio, NestJS, and PostgreSQL on the same booking data model behind Cartivo and RentHub, it turned a manual reminder chore into a self-running pipeline with a visibly lower no-show rate.
